title: Notification-preferences surface renders when application-notifications-in-app applied
iWant: a preferences surface with per-category silence and per-channel opt-in controls only when the notifications blueprint is applied
soThat: the shipped surface never lies about what preferences my product actually supports

acceptanceCriteria.description: When application-notifications-in-app is in the applied-blueprint set, GET /account/notifications renders <div data-surface="notifications"> with [data-role="category-silence"] entries per category and [data-role="channel-opt-in"] entries per channel; save-success and save-failure announcements follow the profile surface contract. Absent when notifications-in-app is not applied. Probed by pack check AC-25107-1.

When application-notifications-in-app is not applied, the preferences tab is suppressed (not linked in the settings navigation and returning 404 on direct URL); no preferences form is written to the DOM.
acceptanceCriteria.then: no preferences link appears in navigation, /account/preferences is unreachable and no preferences form is in the DOM
